title: Low-degree part is close to a junta on the influential coordinates
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $\tau>0$. Then there is a Boolean function $g:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ that is a junta on the set $J_\tau(f)=\{\,i\in[n]:\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]\ge\tau\,\}$ of $\tau$-influential coordinates and that approximates the low-degree part $f_{\le k}$ in squared $L^2$ distance, namely
\[
  \E\big[(f_{\le k}(x)-g(x))^2\big]\;\le\;n\,\tau,
\]
where the expectation is taken under the uniform measure on the cube.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
k is a natural number (truncation level)
replaced:
For every $f$, every level $k$ and every $\tau > 0$ there is a function $g$ that is a
junta on the $\tau$-influential coordinates $J_\tau(f)$ and satisfies
$\E\big[(f_{\le k} - g)^2\big] \le n\tau$.
